batches.note: Official manufacturer pages, press releases, brochures and SEC filings located by web search; titles and URLs captured; page content not read (egress-restricted capture environment). All records PARTIALLY_VERIFIED / MEDIUM; no specifications captured.

Small companies and startups found by web search (official product pages, press releases, trade-association directories, investor announcements and industry news). URLs and titles captured; page content not read (egress-restricted capture environment). Company profile facts marked SEARCH_SUMMARY come from search-result summaries of the cited source. All records PARTIALLY_VERIFIED; no specifications captured.

Keyword-driven discovery: equipment and process keywords (e.g. wedge bonder, die sorter, film assisted molding, molecular beam epitaxy, sputtering system, wafer flatness, EUV pellicle, photomask repair, MES, dry vacuum pump, abatement scrubber, process chiller, MEMS release etch, OLED inkjet) searched on the web, prioritising equipment categories with no companies. Each company records its discovery keywords. URLs and titles captured; pages not read. All records PARTIALLY_VERIFIED; no specifications.

Ecosystem widening by keyword search: lapping / polishing, probe cards, power-device test, gas delivery, mask writers, microLED transfer, silicon wafers and CMP / FOUP consumables. URLs and titles captured; pages not read. All records PARTIALLY_VERIFIED; no specifications.
Totals after 2.0 normalisation (schema, reference taxonomy, derived relationships) over Batch 1 plus Batch 2, Batch 3, Batch 4, Batch 5

processes.name: Crystal growth
processes.description: Growth of a single-crystal boule from melt or vapour (e.g. Czochralski or float-zone for silicon, physical vapour transport for SiC).
processes.purpose: Produce defect-controlled single-crystal material of the required orientation, doping and diameter.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Ingot grinding & shaping
processes.description: Cropping, cylindrical grinding and notch/flat forming of the as-grown ingot.
processes.purpose: Bring the ingot to final diameter and mark crystal orientation.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Wafer slicing (wire sawing)
processes.description: Separation of the ingot into wafers, usually by multi-wire sawing; laser-based separation is also used for hard materials such as SiC.
processes.purpose: Convert the ingot into wafers with minimum kerf loss and subsurface damage.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Lapping
processes.description: Abrasive planarisation of both wafer faces after slicing.
processes.purpose: Remove saw damage and establish flatness and parallelism.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Wafer surface & edge grinding
processes.description: Grinding of wafer faces and edge profiling.
processes.purpose: Achieve thickness targets and a robust edge profile.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Wafer polishing
processes.description: Chemical-mechanical polishing of the bare wafer (often double-side) to a mirror finish.
processes.purpose: Deliver the flatness and surface roughness required for device processing.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Final wafer cleaning
processes.description: Wet cleaning of polished wafers before packing.
processes.purpose: Remove particles, metals and organics from prime wafers.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Bare-wafer inspection
processes.description: Inspection and geometry measurement of incoming or outgoing bare wafers.
processes.purpose: Qualify wafer geometry and surface defectivity.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Epitaxy
processes.description: Growth of a single-crystal film on a single-crystal substrate, e.g. Si or SiC homo-epitaxy, or GaN/GaAs/InP compound layers by MOCVD or MBE.
processes.purpose: Create layers with controlled doping, composition and thickness that the substrate alone cannot provide.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Wafer cleaning
processes.description: Removal of particles, organic and metallic contaminants and native oxide, by wet (batch or single-wafer) or dry/plasma methods. Repeated many times in the flow.
processes.purpose: Keep surfaces free of contaminants that cause yield loss.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Oxidation
processes.description: Thermal growth of silicon dioxide by exposing silicon to oxygen or steam at high temperature.
processes.purpose: Form gate, field or masking oxides.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Diffusion
processes.description: High-temperature redistribution of dopants in a furnace.
processes.purpose: Form junctions and wells.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Deposition (thin films)
processes.description: Addition of dielectric, semiconductor or metal films by chemical (CVD, ALD) or physical (PVD) methods.
processes.purpose: Build the device and interconnect layer stack.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Chemical vapour deposition (CVD)
processes.description: Film formation from gas-phase precursors reacting at or near the wafer surface, thermally or plasma-enhanced.
processes.purpose: Deposit conformal dielectric and conductive films.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Atomic layer deposition (ALD)
processes.description: Self-limiting, sequential surface reactions that deposit films one atomic layer per cycle.
processes.purpose: Deposit ultra-thin, highly conformal films (high-k, liners, spacers).
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Physical vapour deposition (PVD)
processes.description: Deposition of metal or compound films by sputtering a target or evaporating a source in vacuum.
processes.purpose: Form barrier, seed and metal layers.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Photoresist coat & bake
processes.description: Spin-coating of photoresist and associated bake steps on a coater/developer track linked to the scanner.
processes.purpose: Apply a uniform radiation-sensitive film for patterning.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Lithography (exposure)
processes.description: Transfer of the mask (reticle) pattern into the resist by projection exposure (EUV, DUV/ArF, KrF, i-line), direct write (e-beam, laser) or nanoimprint.
processes.purpose: Define circuit patterns at the required resolution and overlay.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Develop
processes.description: Post-exposure bake and dissolution of exposed (or unexposed) resist.
processes.purpose: Reveal the resist pattern.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Etch
processes.description: Selective removal of material through the resist mask, by plasma (dry) or chemical (wet) etching.
processes.purpose: Transfer the pattern into the underlying film or substrate.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Ash / resist strip
processes.description: Removal of residual photoresist by oxygen plasma (ashing) or wet strippers.
processes.purpose: Clear resist after etch or implant.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Ion implantation
processes.description: Acceleration of dopant ions into the wafer at controlled energy and dose.
processes.purpose: Introduce dopants to form wells, sources/drains and junctions.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Annealing / RTP
processes.description: Thermal treatment to activate dopants and repair damage, in furnaces, rapid thermal processors or with laser (millisecond/nanosecond) annealing.
processes.purpose: Activate dopants and control diffusion within a thermal budget.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Chemical mechanical planarisation (CMP)
processes.description: Combined chemical and mechanical polishing to planarise dielectric and metal layers.
processes.purpose: Provide planar surfaces for subsequent lithography and remove overburden.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Metallisation & plating
processes.description: Formation of interconnect metal, typically barrier/seed by PVD then copper electroplating (damascene).
processes.purpose: Build the multilevel wiring.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Metrology
processes.description: Measurement of film thickness, critical dimensions, overlay and surface properties.
processes.purpose: Monitor and control process steps.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Defect inspection & review
processes.description: Detection, classification and review of defects on patterned and unpatterned wafers (optical, e-beam).
processes.purpose: Find yield-limiting defects early.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Mask / reticle making
processes.description: Writing, inspecting, repairing and qualifying photomasks and reticles.
processes.purpose: Produce defect-free masks for lithography.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Wafer probe & electrical test
processes.description: Electrical testing of each die on the wafer using a prober, probe card and automated test equipment.
processes.purpose: Identify good dies before assembly (known-good die).
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Back-grinding / wafer thinning
processes.description: Grinding and stress-relief polishing of the wafer backside to the target thickness.
processes.purpose: Reduce package height and enable stacking.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Wafer mounting
processes.description: Laminating the wafer onto dicing tape on a frame.
processes.purpose: Hold dies in place during and after dicing.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Dicing
processes.description: Separation of the wafer into individual dies by blade sawing, laser ablation, stealth (internal) laser modification or plasma etching.
processes.purpose: Singulate dies with minimal chipping and kerf.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Die attach
processes.description: Pick-and-place of dies onto a leadframe or substrate using adhesive, solder or sinter materials.
processes.purpose: Mechanically and thermally attach the die.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Wire bonding
processes.description: Connection of die pads to package leads with fine gold, copper or aluminium wire (ball or wedge bonding).
processes.purpose: Provide electrical interconnect.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Flip-chip bonding
processes.description: Face-down attachment of bumped dies to a substrate by mass reflow or thermo-compression bonding.
processes.purpose: Area-array interconnect with short electrical paths.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Molding / encapsulation
processes.description: Encapsulation of assemblies with epoxy molding compound (transfer or compression molding) and dispensing of underfill.
processes.purpose: Protect the die and interconnect.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Lead plating & finishing
processes.description: Plating of external leads for solderability.
processes.purpose: Ensure board-level solderability.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Marking
processes.description: Laser (or ink) marking of packages, strips or wafers with identifiers.
processes.purpose: Provide traceability and product identification.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Package singulation
processes.description: Sawing, punching or laser cutting of molded strips into individual packages.
processes.purpose: Separate finished packages.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Package inspection
processes.description: Automated optical and X-ray inspection of packages for mechanical and internal defects.
processes.purpose: Screen out assembly defects.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Final / package test
processes.description: Electrical test of packaged devices with ATE and handlers, across temperature where required.
processes.purpose: Guarantee shipped-product quality and bin by performance.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Burn-in & reliability
processes.description: Stressing devices at elevated voltage and temperature to screen early-life failures.
processes.purpose: Remove infant-mortality failures.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Through-silicon via (TSV)
processes.description: Vertical vias etched through silicon, lined, filled with metal and revealed from the backside.
processes.purpose: Vertical interconnect for 3D stacks and interposers.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Through-glass via (TGV) & glass core
processes.description: Formation of vias in glass substrates or interposers, commonly by laser modification followed by wet etching, or by laser drilling.
processes.purpose: Enable glass-core substrates and glass interposers.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Redistribution layer (RDL)
processes.description: Thin-film wiring layers (polymer dielectric + plated copper) that re-route die I/O.
processes.purpose: Fan in/out interconnect at wafer or panel level.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Wafer-level packaging (fan-in)
processes.description: Packaging performed on the whole wafer before singulation, with I/O within the die footprint.
processes.purpose: Chip-scale packages with minimal footprint.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Fan-out wafer/panel-level packaging
processes.description: Dies embedded in a reconstituted wafer or panel with RDL extending beyond the die edge.
processes.purpose: Higher I/O density without a substrate.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: 2.5D integration (interposer)
processes.description: Side-by-side placement of dies on a silicon, organic or glass interposer or bridge.
processes.purpose: High-bandwidth die-to-die connectivity (e.g. logic + HBM).
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: 3D stacking & HBM
processes.description: Vertical stacking of dies (e.g. DRAM stacks for HBM) connected by TSVs and microbumps or direct/hybrid bonds.
processes.purpose: Increase bandwidth and density per footprint.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Chiplet integration
processes.description: Assembly of multiple smaller dies (chiplets) into one package via 2.5D/3D or advanced substrates.
processes.purpose: Heterogeneous integration and yield improvement.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Hybrid / direct bonding
processes.description: Bonding of dies or wafers through direct dielectric-dielectric and Cu-Cu contact without solder.
processes.purpose: Sub-10 µm pitch interconnect for 3D integration.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Temporary bond / debond
processes.description: Temporary attachment of thin wafers to carriers and later release (e.g. by laser debonding).
processes.purpose: Handle thin wafers through backside processing.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Advanced substrate & panel processing
processes.description: Build-up substrate and panel-level processes: via drilling, lithography and plating on large-format panels.
processes.purpose: High-density substrates for large packages.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Laser lift-off
processes.description: Separation of a film or device layer from a transparent carrier by laser absorption at the interface.
processes.purpose: Release flexible displays or MicroLEDs from growth/carrier substrates.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Laser annealing (LTPS / display)
processes.description: Laser crystallisation of amorphous silicon into polysilicon for display backplanes.
processes.purpose: High-mobility thin-film transistors.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: MicroLED mass transfer & repair
processes.description: Transfer of large numbers of MicroLED dies to the backplane and repair of defective pixels.
processes.purpose: Assemble MicroLED displays.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Automated material handling
processes.description: Overhead hoist transport, stockers and vehicles that move FOUPs between tools.
processes.purpose: Deliver wafers to tools without manual handling.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Tool automation & wafer handling
processes.description: EFEMs, wafer robots, load ports and factory software linking tools to the fab.
processes.purpose: Automated, contamination-free wafer transfer and tool control.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Vacuum & abatement (subfab)
processes.description: Dry, turbo and cryo pumps creating process vacuum, and abatement systems that treat process exhaust.
processes.purpose: Maintain process vacuum and destroy hazardous or greenhouse exhaust gases.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Gas & chemical delivery
processes.description: Gas cabinets, valve manifold boxes, bulk gas and chemical distribution that feed tools.
processes.purpose: Deliver pure, controlled process fluids safely.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

processes.name: Utilities (UPW, CDA, cooling, power)
processes.description: Ultrapure water, clean dry air, process cooling, waste treatment, power distribution and facility monitoring.
processes.purpose: Provide the utilities every tool depends on.
processes.content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

technologies.name: Reactive ion etch (RIE)
